prose: VentureBeat details the Gemini 4 Carbon commercial rollout: selected cybersecurity defenders get access first through Google's curated Fairwind Program, at introductory prices of $2 per million input tokens and $10 per million output - matching Argon's launch rates - with a 95% cached-input discount. A footnote reveals later prices of $4 and $20, timing unspecified.

Artificial Analysis ranks Carbon (high reasoning) first on Intelligence Index v5.0 with 59, ahead of Claude Opus 5.5 (58), GPT-6 Astra (57) and Argon (50). Carbon tops 15 of 17 benchmark rows in Google's own chart, though OpenAI keeps one software engineering lead and Anthropic one computer-use lead. Independent testing notes tradeoffs alongside the gains.
highlights: Carbon via Fairwind first: $2/$10 per million tokens, rising to $4/$20
AA Index: 59 vs Opus 5.5's 58 and Astra's 57
Tops 15 of 17 benchmarks; OpenAI and Anthropic keep one lead each
